text:
jordan: Noticed a spike of 5xxs for /v2/reconcile in eu-central and us-west around 04:22 UTC. Traces show many connections stuck in CLOSE_WAIT on backend pool and LB retry storms.

mei: Put a quick grep in logs 4% of requests to that route had 3+ retries in a 2m window. Looks like conn pool exhaustion on backend-hostpool-2 then cross-region failover kicked in.

lina: This pattern smells like a client-side retry policy that doesn't account for backend saturation. We should consider both infra mitigations and policy changes.

samir: Agreed. Immediate checklist I propose: 1) temporarily set max retries=0 for /v2/reconcile in routing layer for affected regions (owner: samir, ETA: 2h) 2) bump backend-hostpool-2 keepalive limits + restart processes (owner: mei, ETA: 6h) 3) enable a per-route token-bucket limiter to protect backend on bursts (owner: lina, ETA: EOD)

netops-bot: Created INC-20401 and linked runbook. Subscribers: jordan, mei, lina, samir.

oncall: Can we add a detection rule that triggers before retries pile up? Maybe alert on conn pool fullness and retry count growing together.

jordan: I can sketch three alerts: (1) conn_pool_util > 80% for 3m, (2) retry_rate > 0.15 for 3m, (3) backend_error_ratio > 0.05 for 2m. If two of three fire, page oncall. Owner: jordan, ETA: 4h.

mei: For postmortem actions: - run a focused chaos test reducing pool sizes to see failure modes - audit SDK retry config across services - investigate whether TLS handshake timeouts preceded the stuck conns (we saw a few TLS timeouts in traces).

lina: I'll own the chaos test plan (owner: lina, ETA: next Wednesday). samir: can you own the SDK retry audit?

samir: Yep. I9ll inventory services calling /v2/reconcile and propose a uniform retry/backoff policy with jitter (owner: samir, ETA: next Fri).

jordan: Also propose a short-term routing rule: prefer local region backends when pool util < 75% to avoid cross-region ejection thrash. That would cut unnecessary failovers. Owner: jordan, ETA: next Tue.

oncall: Add recurring review: mark this as "potential repeating pattern: connpool + aggressive retries + cross-region ejection". We'll add it to weekly incident trends.

lina: I'll post a short thread summary and attach p95/p99 charts and a span sample to INC-20401 after my limiter config lands.

mei: After we deploy mitigations, let's validate with a controlled canary and a replay of the spike using preserved traffic. I9ll coordinate the replay windows.

samir: Noted. Also adding a small doc snippet to the SDK repo explaining why infinite retries are harmful for stateful routes.

jordan: Thanks team. Catch-up sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC. I'll update INC-20401 with owners and timelines. :thumbsup:

oncall: I'll add the alert rules to the ticket and stitch dashboards.

netops-bot: INC-20401 status updated: mitigations in progress.
